label: The bootstrap sample: for j = 1, 2, …, N, draw x* sub j independently from the set { x sub 1, …, x sub N } with equal probability one over N, with replacement
Gini impurity of a node: G equals the sum over classes c of p of c times one minus p of c — the probability that two items drawn at random from the node are given different labels

The best split: the feature f star and threshold t star that minimize the weighted Gini impurity of the two child nodes — p of L times G of L plus p of R times G of R — where p of L and p of R are the fractions of the parent's rows that fall left and right
The forest prediction by majority vote: y hat equals the class c that maximizes, over c, the sum over the B trees of the indicator that tree b's own prediction for x equals c
